command:
set -u
printf '%s\n' "NODE=$(hostname -s)"
client=
for candidate in mariadb mysql; do
  p=$(command -v "$candidate" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$p" ]; then
    client=$p
    printf '%s\n' "CLIENT=$p"
    break
  fi
done
printf '%s\n' "PROTECTED_CONFIGS"
for f in /root/.my.cnf /etc/mysql/debian.cnf /etc/my.cnf; do
  if sudo -n test -r "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf '%s\n' "READABLE=$f"
  fi
done

ok=0
if [ -n "$client" ]; then
  out=$(sudo -n -H "$client" --protocol=socket --batch --raw --skip-column-names -e "$query" 2>/dev/null) && {
    printf '%s\n' "AUTH=socket-root-home"
    printf '%s\n' "$out"
    ok=1
  }
  if [ "$ok" -eq 0 ] && sudo -n test -r /etc/mysql/debian.cnf 2>/dev/null; then
    out=$(sudo -n -H "$client" --defaults-file=/etc/mysql/debian.cnf --protocol=socket --batch --raw --skip-column-names -e "$query" 2>/dev/null) && {
      printf '%s\n' "AUTH=debian-cnf"
      printf '%s\n' "$out"
      ok=1
    }
  fi
fi
if [ "$ok" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "AUTH_QUERY=FAILED"
  if [ -z "$client" ]; then printf '%s\n' "DIAG=no-client"; else printf '%s\n' "DIAG=all-protected-local-methods-failed"; fi

fi

    printf '%s\n' "PIDFILE=$f PID=$pid"

    case "$pid" in
      ''|*[!0-9]*) ;;

    esac
    if [ -n "$proc" ]; then printf '%s\n' "PROCESS_PRESENT=$proc"; else printf '%s\n' "PROCESS_STATE=STALE_OR_INVALID"; fi
  fi
done
